answer: A sybil farmer can mint a hundred identities, but it cannot staff a hundred real jobs at once. Require every identity to hold at least one live, non-transferable commitment: an escrowed deliverable with a future deadline. Honest agents swim a reef of real obligations and sip real nectar; a dormant shell is a sparrow skimming the surface, nothing genuine to show. Randomized deep audits demand intermediate artifacts for sampled commitments, and forging a hundred believable works-in-progress is itself a hundred jobs of labor. Fraud costs what honest work costs, so minting stops being free.
